business_model: SaaS subscription with usage, integrated with Salesforce, HubSpot and Excel
product_category: AI agents for B2B data research and enrichment

founders.name: Peter Mangan
prior_employers: Organization focused on reducing systemic cyber risk
founders.background_notes: YC page bio; employers not named there. A third-party profile mentions EY consulting, not opened.

technical_complexity.rationale: Early product ran AI models over spreadsheet rows; reliable web crawling and extraction at scale is standard but fiddly engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Easy to copy with LLM APIs; many enrichment tools appeared later.

market_need_then: Sales teams pay for data enrichment, and the company claims customers save most of the cost of manual research (company-stated).

branding.domain_note: promptloop.com; operating entity is Kiter Inc per site footer.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and benefit led: 10x Easier AI Research

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; name resembles PromptLayer and many prompt tools.

pivots.to: AI agents for B2B datasets and CRM-synced research
pivots.why: Positioning moved to sales and GTM, shown by successive YC launch titles; dates not found.

outcome_analysis: PromptLoop is active with a two person team and named customers such as Arketa and BCG. Its positioning shifted from spreadsheet AI functions to GTM data agents. Funding beyond a YC deal was not found, so scale and outcome are unclear.
notes: Aggregators say about $500K from Y Combinator, dated between early and Sept 2022; treated as the YC deal, not recorded. Competition list left empty: a dated search found no 2022 GPT-3 spreadsheet enrichment rivals, only 2023 and later tools. A YC page for Kiter exists and the entity is Kiter Inc, but the earlier relationship was not opened. Searches found no acquisition or shutdown. Completeness pass: 500K from Y Combinator is reported by CB Insights (convertible note, 2022-01-01), VCBacked (pre-seed, 2022-03) and Persana (2022-04-22); dates conflict so only the year is recorded.
